_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil with already-priced opposing factors and no fresh breaker makes HOLD the honest base-rate call; Complacency is the only legal +1 if the range holds.
next_move.brains_agree: Analyst explicit HOLD to Complacency; narrative silent on forward phase so no direct conflict
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed stays 42-55, 30d BTC change inside roughly -8% to +5%, ETF flows stay suppressed
next_move.invalidated_if: Fear & Greed under 35 with funding negative and downside accelerating, or ETF flows rebound hard with Fear & Greed above 60 and momentum flip
